tool.name: nf-core calder2
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ # getting binsize as mandatory input for calder binsize="\$(cooler info --field bin-size $cool$suffix)"
calder --input $cool$suffix \\ --outpath ${prefix} \\ --nproc $cpus \\ --type cool \\ --bin_size "\${binsize}" \\ $args
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": calder: $VERSION END_VERSIONS ]]>
